text: Not only are there so many ads it's becoming too frustrating to use but now after the latest update if you use YouTube in "split screen" while using another app with it the video sometimes glitches out and leaves a green screen, the audio still works fine, the video doesn't, after that the app crashes. I understand that apps don't always work well with split screen but it had not been an issue for me before the update, right now to me it's pretty much unusable.
